date.as_written: samvat 511 śrāvaṇamāse kṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ caitranakṣatre dhruvayoge śaniścaravāsare

purpose: Pious gift (deyadharma); merit dedicated first to the teachers (vajrācārya/upādhyāya) and parents, then to all beings, for the attainment of supreme knowledge
notes: The donor passage is corrupt. 'paramopāśikaḥ' looks like the feminine upāsikā, while '‥jasarāmakasya' is a masculine genitive. So the donor may be an unnamed laywoman, with ‥jasarāma a related man (perhaps her husband), or the forms are simply garbled. The first syllable of the name is lost: Tejasarāma or Jayarāma are possible but unproven. 'lalitavyūmāyā' is probably Lalitabrūmāyāṃ (Patan). 'māṇigala' is Maṅgal Bazaar in Patan. 'pantivihāralivisthaṃ' is unclear and might mean a resident (-vāsin/-stha) of a 'Panti' vihāra. The text gives no scribe and no place of copying. NS 511 = 1391 CE, which falls within the reign of Jayasthiti Malla (c. 1382–1395) and matches the catalogue fields.
